build_InceptionV3_model: build a pretrained InceptionV3 model to extract feature maps from input images for FID computation
run_InceptionV3_forward: run the InceptionV3 forward pass on a batch of images to get feature vectors
create_fid_inception_v3: create a FID-specific InceptionV3 model with patched blocks matching TensorFlow weights
review_FIDInceptionA_forward: review the FIDInceptionA forward method that patches average pooling to exclude padded zeros
summarize_FIDInceptionE_2: summarize the FIDInceptionE_2 class that uses max pooling instead of average pooling
